thread:
zoe: Heads up - noticed a $45,212.60 spike in GPU spend attributed to dedicated-pool-west on invoice INV-2026-05-02. Looks tied to the quantization rollout last week.

harry: Oh right, we flipped q4 -> q3 for smaller mem footprint. Did we change any autoscale or instance types?

zoe: Change log shows only model binary swap, but monitoring shows longer runtimes per request, so more GPU-hours. Billing export lines: line 2201-2205.

kevin: If the rollout increased latency and GPU-hours, we need a chargeback plan for the experiment. Was this prod or canary?

harry: It was a phased rollout: 10% canary then 100% after judged OK. Canary ran 4/27-4/28, full on 4/29. Canary logs didn't show drift but sample size small.

billing-bot: Reminder: experiments that cause >$10k delta require finance review and a remediation plan (policy EXP-02).

zoe: I'm proposing we: 1) attribute 100% of incremental cost above baseline to Eng-Experiment budget (exp-budget-2026), 2) run retro fix to revert model if quality/latency worse, 3) bill customers only after review.

kevin: Agree to step 1 tentatively. Need a baseline calculation document and approvals. Can you attach diff numbers?

zoe: Baseline (avg GPU-hours/day pre-rollout): 1200h. Post-rollout (4/29-5/02): 1650h. Incremental ~450h * a100 rate = $45,212.60. Filed ticket BL-2026-621 with logs and perf graphs.

harry: We'll open rollback PR if regression confirmed. Also adding telemetry to capture per-request GPU-time to prevent future blind spots.

gcp-rep: I can pull provider-side instance lifecycle logs if you need resource-level confirmation for the invoice rows.

kevin: Please add the provider logs to BL-2026-621 and cc finance lead. Finance will post a journal entry moving $45,212.60 from unallocated -> exp-budget-2026 once ticket has audit attachments.

billing-bot: Ticket BL-2026-621 created. Include 'experiment_note' in the audit metadata for compliance.

zoe: Added provider logs and perf graphs. Marking this 'action required' for eng to decide revert. Closing thread when journal entry posted.
